request.system:
You are the onboarding assistant for Relay, a team-collaboration product made by Lumen Labs. You help the admin of a customer account set up their workspace.

Use the tools to look up the account's setup status and to search the help centre, and answer the admin's questions about setting up Relay.

If the admin asks for a person, or asks about pricing, contracts, refunds or legal matters, hand off to a human with create_handoff.

Be helpful and concise.

content.text:
Sorry you've hit a problem. I'd like to help, but I need a bit more detail to work out what's going wrong.

Here's where your workspace is right now:
- ✅ First board created
- ⬜ Invite at least five users (4 of your 15 seats are in use)
- ⬜ Connect an integration
- ⬜ Set up single sign-on (SSO)

Since you're partway through setup, it's probably one of the steps above. Could you tell me:
1. **What were you trying to do?** For example, inviting a user, connecting an integration or setting up SSO.
2. **What happened?** Did you get an error message (the exact wording helps), did a button do nothing, or did something not show up?

Once I know that, I'll find the right steps in the help centre.

messages.content: Sorry: the invitation emails. My colleagues never received them.

content.content:
{"query": "invitation email not received", "note": "At least one article covers this question.", "articles": [{"slug": "invites-not-arriving", "title": "Invitation emails are not arriving", "score": 6.27, "coverage": 1.0, "covers_question": true, "text": "# Invitation emails are not arriving

If an invited colleague did not receive the invitation:
1. Ask them to check their spam or junk folder.
2. Check the address under Admin settings, Users, Pending invitations. A typo is the most common cause.
3. Click Resend next to the invitation. The old link stops working.
4. If your company filters external email, ask your IT team to allow mail from relay-mail.lumenlabs.example.

Invitations expire after seven days. An expired invitation still holds a seat until you cancel or resend it.

Search keywords: invite invites invitation not received missing did not arrive email never came
"}, {"slug": "invite-users", "title": "Invite your team", "score": 5.11, "coverage": 1.0, "covers_question": true, "text": "# Invite your team

Admins invite people from Admin settings, Users, Invite. Type one email address per line or paste a list. Each invited person receives an email with a link that is valid for seven days.

You can invite as many people as you have licensed seats. A seat is used as soon as the invitation is sent, and freed again if you cancel the invitation or deactivate the user.

Tip: teams that invite at least five people in their first week are far more likely to keep using Relay, because boards are only useful when the work of several people is on them.

Search keywords: add people colleagues members team teammates new users invite invitation
"}, {"slug": "bulk-invite", "title": "Invite many users at once (bulk invite)", "score": 3.0, "coverage": 0.67, "covers_question": false, "text": "# Invite many users at once (bulk invite)

To add many people at once, go to Admin settings, Users, Invite, and choose Upload a file. Upload a CSV file with one column named email. You can add an optional column named role with the value member or admin.

Relay checks the file first and shows you any addresses it cannot use (wrong format, already a user, or more rows than free seats). Nothing is sent until you confirm.

There is no limit on the size of the file other than the number of seats you have free.

Search keywords: add whole team everyone all at once many people dozen dozens hundreds list import upload
"}]}

tools.name: get_account_context
tools.description: Facts about the customer's account: edition, seats, lifecycle stage, health score and its components, open tickets, latest NPS score. Call it when the answer depends on the customer's edition or situation.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Which of the four setup steps the account has completed (first board, five users, an integration, single sign-on) and which are still missing. Call it first in an onboarding conversation.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Relay help centre. Returns the best-matching articles with their full text. Answer product questions only from what this returns.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words.

tools.name: create_handoff
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human, with a summary. Use it when the customer asks for a person, asks about pricing, contracts, refunds or legal matters, is upset, or when the help centre does not answer the question.

summary.description: What the customer wants and what was already tried.

tools.name: log_outcome
tools.description: Record how the conversation ended. Call it once, at the end.

note.description: One sentence on what was resolved.

input.note: Gave the help-centre troubleshooting steps for invitation emails that don't arrive (spam folder, typo check, resend, IT allowlist, 7-day expiry).
